findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe use of eval/exec
 * @description Detects any use of eval or exec within the requests package implementation.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/requests-eval-exec
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of eval/exec can lead to code injection vulnerabilities if given untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: The package might use eval/exec internally, which would be dangerous if ever exposed to untrusted input.

message.text: Use of eval/exec can lead to code injection vulnerabilities if given untrusted input.
